expectations.evidence: "POST /auth/login is a public endpoint (permitAll())." and "AuthService.login() POSTs { email, password } to /auth/login."

expectations.text: Mentions JWT token generation (JwtService or equivalent)
expectations.evidence: "JwtService.generateToken() creates a signed JWT with the email as subject, issued-at timestamp, and expiration."

expectations.text: Mentions localStorage as where the token is stored on the frontend
expectations.evidence: "On success, the JWT access_token is stored in localStorage (key: access_token) via persistToken()."

expectations.text: Mentions AuthTokenInterceptor as the mechanism that attaches the Bearer header
expectations.evidence: "authTokenInterceptor (registered as an HttpInterceptorFn in app.config.ts) runs on every HTTP request. If a token exists in AuthService, it clones the request and adds the Authorization: Bearer <token> header."

expectations.text: Mentions JwtAuthFilter as the backend token validation component
expectations.evidence: "JwtAuthFilter (a OncePerRequestFilter) intercepts every request. It reads the Authorization header, strips the Bearer prefix, and calls JwtService.extractUsername(token) to get the email."

expectations.text: Mentions user roles (ADMIN and CUSTOMER) and @PreAuthorize for method-level enforcement
expectations.evidence: "Admin-only operations (create/update/delete products and categories) are annotated with @PreAuthorize(\"hasRole('ADMIN')\")." and "sets the role to CUSTOMER (hardcoded — users can only self-register as customers)" and "UserDetailsServiceImpl maps the UserRole enum to a Spring granted authority as ROLE_<role> (e.g., ROLE_ADMIN, ROLE_CUSTOMER)."

expectations.text: Mentions Angular guards (authGuard and/or rolesGuard) for route protection
expectations.evidence: "rolesGuard protects routes that require a specific role." and "authGuard: Protects all main app routes — Redirects to /auth/login if not authenticated" (in Route Guards Summary table).
